name: Gouonji Akira
source:
Gouonji Akira is a 62-year-old owner of the hospital. He has 3 daughters. He has no son so he wants his daughter Shizuka to marry Rokuhara Osamu, a doctor from his hospital, and leave the hospital to him.
His youngest daughter, Aoi, hates him for marrying another woman and forgetting about their mother.
